versions.changelog: v3.2.0: 扩展wanx支持15种宽高比, 中文别名, --list-sizes, 自动像素缩放

- Major upgrade to V3: now features intent recognition (40+ scenarios), structured prompt building, a 30+ style dictionary, and intelligent multi-engine routing (Wanx/Seedream4/Seedream5).
- User confirmation required before image generation.
- Added 26+ scenario templates (business cards, posters, avatars, 3D objects, weather cards, etc.).
- Supports smart mode (intent recognition + template matching + engine routing), field customization, and raw prompt compatibility.
- Enhanced style selection and flexible API key setup; supports multiple providers and DeepSeek LLM for advanced parsing.
- Comprehensive command-line usage and workflow guidance included.
